We protect people on their digital journey from the ever-evolving cyber threats!

What people may not realise is that the digital terrain we navigate can sometimes be dangerous. With phishing attempts, malicious content, malware and many other cyber threats lurking around every corner, we can easily expose ourselves, our organisations and our data to potential risks.

Cyan's round-the-clock protection gives you the peace of mind that comes from having a robust cyber security solution wherever you are. We offer white-label solutions to our customers in the telecommunications, financial services and other industries s... 1 Vice President Global Sales (m/f/d) The position
Ready to shape the global growth of a cybersecurity company and build the sales organization behind its next success story?

Your mission
 * Take ownership of our international sales activities and drive cyan's continued growth
 * Lead, support and further develop our international sales team in its day-to-day business
 * Establish clear targets, responsibilities and scalable sales processes
 * Actively manage the pipeline, improve forecasting and ensure consistent CRM usage
 * Leverage your existing network to generate new opportunities and build a strong, sustainable pipeline
 * Expand our presence within the global Telco market and identify further growth opportunities across our business areas
 * Personally drive key opportunities - from initial contact and presentations to proposals, negotiations and closing
 * Work closely with the CEO and collaborate directly with Product Management, Marketing and Finance
 * Turn ideas into action in a dynamic tech environment with small teams, flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths

Your profile
 * Profound experience in international B2B sales, including a proven track record of closing deals above EUR 500,000 TCV over the past three years in complex buying environments, such as buying committees and tender processes
 * A strong track record in channel, partner or enterprise sales, including sustained annual growth of more than 15% over several years. An established network in relevant industries that enables you to open doors and create new business opportunities
 * Experience in cybersecurity, telecommunications, enterprise software or a comparable technology environment
 * Proven ability to lead and grow sales teams and establish effective structures and processes
 * Experience managing complex sales cycles and negotiating with senior and C-level decision-makers
 * A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach - you are comfortable creating presentations, proposals and business cases yourself
 * Strong commercial judgment, ownership and a clear focus on execution and results
 * Fluency in English is required 
 * Willingness to travel internationally

Why us?
 * Shape the international growth of a listed cybersecurity company by working closely with our CEO and benefiting from short decision-making paths.
 * Enjoy significant ownership and freedom to build and develop our global sales organization 
 * Work on cybersecurity solutions with real impact for customers and users worldwide 
 * Benefit from an attractive compensation package, including a performance-based variable component 
 * Hybrid working and modern equipment 
 * Enjoy a modern office in central Vienna, including a public transport pass, snacks, drinks and fresh daily meals 
 * Regular team events and opportunities to attend international industry events

 
The position offers a competitive fixed salary of around EUR 10,000 gross/month plus a performance-based variable component of up to 50%, depending on experience and overall package. Of course, there is the possibility of overpayment depending on experience and qualifications.

Apply now: https://ams.at/su/rdvNw Das Mindestentgelt für die Stelle als Vice President Global Sales (m/f/d) beträgt 10.000,00 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Basis Vollzeitbeschäftigung. Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Spanish-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

1 Specialist Funding and R&D Excellence In your role, you will work on strengthening and managing AT&S's network of research, industry, and public funding partners. The role supports the identification, establishment, and maintenance of strategic collaborations and contributes to the preparation and execution of (funded) R&D activities. In addition, the position maintains partner-related information, supports consortium building, and helps increase the visibility and effectiveness of AT&S's external innovation ecosystem. Through close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, the role contributes to the successful execution of AT&S's research and innovation strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 
 * Develop and maintain strategic relationships with universities, research institutes, industrial partners, clusters, and funding-related stakeholders to strengthen AT&S's innovation ecosystem and collaboration opportunities
 * Identify, evaluate, and recommend potential collaboration partners aligned with AT&S's technology roadmap and R&D priorities to expand strategic networks and create future innovation opportunities
 * Maintain and further develop partner relationship management tools, databases, and processes to ensure transparency, accessibility, and quality of partner-related information
 * Prepare analyses, reports, and management summaries on partner activities, collaboration opportunities, and innovation ecosystem developments
 * Support the preparation of national and international funding proposals to increase public funding opportunities
 * Facilitate consortium building and stakeholder coordination for collaborative R&D projects to ensure effective project initiation and execution
 * Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration across AT&S and external organizations through networking activities, workshops, and best-practice exchange
 * Support the organization, coordination, and execution of partner events, workshops, innovation forums, and networking activities 

Your Profile 
 * University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Innovation Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
 * Several years of professional experience in R&D, innovation management, public funding, collaboration management, project management, or a related area
 * (Strong) technical understanding of semiconductor packaging, IC substrate technologies, PCB technologies, advanced manufacturing technologies, or related fields
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with CRM, database, or collaboration management tools is beneficial
 * Experience in collaborating with external partners in industrial or research environments
 * Good understanding of public funding programs, collaborative R&D projects, universities, research organizations, or familiarity with national and/or European funding programs is an advantage
 * Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders
 * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously
 * Analytical mindset with the ability to prepare reports, presentations, and management summaries
 * Fluent English and German language skills 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

 https://career.ats.net/job/Leoben-Specialist-Funding-and-R&D-Excellence/1425963033/

collaboratively

1 Presales Consultant (m/w/d) Your tasks
 *  Manage the lifecycle of framework agreements and multi-year customer contracts in a technically and legally complex environment.
 * Support pre-sales activities and business development for Mission Critical Networks (MCN) across the DACH region.
 * Prepare, negotiate, and maintain service, maintenance, and long-term support agreements (e.g., MCO, MCS, LTS) and develop Cyber PACS offerings.
 * Prepare and cost commercial proposals for 5G, RAN, MCx, BSS, and NSS solutions, including upgrades, spare parts, price revisions, and training.
 * Develop tailored technical solutions for Mission Critical Networks in the transportation sector while considering technical, commercial, and financial requirements.
 * Perform commercial and financial analyses of proposals and assess Kontron Transportation's contractual commitments.
 * Present technical and commercial solutions to customers and act as the key interface for communication with internal and external stakeholders.
 * Provide technical support during customer negotiations in close collaboration with the Sales team and take ownership of the customer solutions portfolio covering products and services.
 * Ensure compliance with internal approval and governance processes for commercial proposals.

Your qualifications:
 * Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
 * Experience in pre-sales, business development, sales engineering, project management, or delivery within the telecommunications industry, including customer-facing responsibilities.
 * Proven experience managing framework agreements and multi-year contracts in technically and commercially complex environments.
 * Strong expertise in Mission Critical Networks, including GSM-R, FRMCS, 4G/5G, MCx, IP technologies, and professional mobile communication solutions.
 * Solid understanding of deployment, operation, and maintenance services for railway and mission-critical communication networks.
 * Experience preparing and delivering complex telecom proposals or large-scale customer projects, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical experts as well as executive stakeholders (CxO level).
 * Good knowledge of the transportation telecommunications ecosystem, including radio access networks, terminals, transmission technologies, and railway services.
 * Fluent in English; additional language skills such as German or Slavic languages are considered an advantage.
 * Strong analytical, organizational, and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into customer-oriented solutions.
 * Self-driven, collaborative, and proactive team player with a passion for innovation and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Our offer
Community and Success - these are the values that define the way we work together. Become part of our motivated, international team:

 * Open communication and a culture of informal collaboration across all international locations
 * Flexible working hours and home-office options
 * An environment that welcomes new ideas and encourages initiative
 * Individual training and development opportunities based on regular employee discussions
 * A modern office at the Vienna Technology Hub, surrounded by numerous restaurants and excellent infrastructure
 * Regular company events and team activities
 * A wide range of attractive benefits (e.g. meal vouchers, corporate health promotion, company bike program, additional days off for volunteering activities and birthdays, commuting allowance)

We offer a market-competitive gross annual salary starting from EUR 76,000 per year. An overpayment depending on the candidate's actual qualifications and professional experience is intended.

Founded in 2020 to solve the biggest challenges in the energy industry, enspired has been pushing the boundaries of innovation since day one. Driven by the belief that technology will make the energy transition a reality, we developed a state-of-the-art optimization platform in the early days of algo trading to integrate the flexibility we need for an efficient and sustainable energy system.

Today we know that future-proof battery revenues are the backbone of the renewable buildout. As the leader of the transparency movement in BESS revenue assessment, we publish verifiable commercial results to establish a new, reliable benchmarking standard that helps battery owners get a true understanding of what their asset is worth. 1 Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) Join us and help drive the energy transition

Have you always wanted to be part of a team that makes a difference? As the leading optimizer of Grid Scale Storage across Europe, we do just that! We are expanding our team and looking for a Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) who wants to play a key role in strengthening our position across Europe. As part of our Growth Team, you will enjoy strong go-to-market support from both marketing and business development.

Note: We can consider candidates based in Austria, Belgium, Slovakia, Spain, and the UK

Ready to make a difference? As part of our handpicked growth team, you will

 * Build relationships with renewable and grid-scale storage developers in your region

 * Take full responsibility for the entire B2B sales cycle

 * Manage opportunities, your pipeline, and close deals

 * Work with your colleagues to provide value at every stage of a client's project

 * Share our vision at every touchpoint - calls/events/initiatives

 * Ultimately, win and retain satisfied customers

Job requirements

How you fit into the team

You want to participate in the transition to clean energy actively, and

 * Bring +5 years of quota-carrying sales experience

 * Have an understanding of the power industry and the role that flexibility plays in the energy transition

 * Have competence in complex and solution-oriented sales methods

 * Are enthusiastic when articulating technical and business value

 * Enjoy developing and executing a comprehensive territory plan

 * Are eager to leverage marketing automation strategies

 * Bring perfect oral and written communication in English as well as in Polish or Italian

 * Have been actively involved in the Polish or Italian markets (nice to have)

 * Like to travel and to drive the sales cycle even on business trips

 * Value excellent team spirit and creative freedom

What's in it for you?

We believe in transparency and keep our colleagues updated on every aspect of our business. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of benefits

 * Hybrid and flexible working model

 * 30 days of vacation

 * 60 days of work from anywhere

 * Referral bonus

 * Extensive support of lifelong learners

 * Regular social events and holiday parties in Austria

 * Free lunch & fruits and fair-trade coffee at the office

 * Offsetting your private CO2 emissions

 * Sustainable enspired merch

 * Very competitive compensation package with uncapped commission

 * Continuous sales and industry training

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants. We offer an attractive salary which corresponds to your skills of at least EUR 85.000 gross per year.

1 Communications & Public Affairs Manager (all genders) Key Responsibilities

Communications Hub & Single Source of Truth

 * Serve as the single coordination point through whom all communications decisions, inputs, and outputs flow
 * Build and own zerothird's AI-supported knowledge base: approved messaging, narratives, assets, and institutional knowledge - always current, always accessible
 * Enforce narrative consistency across every output and every channel
 * Turn leadership strategy into a concrete, sequenced operational plan

Agency Interface & Project Management

 * Own the relationship with our external communications and public affairs consultancy: brief, review, push back, and deliver
 * Drive internal sign-off processes; track milestones and open items across all active projects
 * Escalate decisions to management fast, with context and a clear recommendation

Content Creation

 * Continuously mine for content: extract proof points, developments, and stories from R&D, Sales, Management, and external sources and turn them into communications material before the moment passes
 * Review and quality-check for factual accuracy, brand consistency, and tone before sign-off
 * Maintain a structured content calendar aligned with the broader campaign plan

Channel Management

 * Own and operate zerothird's communications channels: website, LinkedIn, newsletters, and owned event formats
 * Manage the content lifecycle from briefing through publication; implement targeting concepts
 * Drive SEO and digital visibility - ensure zerothird is findable where it matters

Corporate Identity

 * Be the internal guardian of zerothird's corporate identity across all formats and channels
 * Work with external design resources to enforce brand standards

Public & Governmental Affairs

 * Act as the operational counterpart to the external consultancy's public affairs leads: schedule meetings with political stakeholders, prepare briefing materials, follow up on engagement activities
 * Monitor relevant regulatory and policy developments and flag them internally

Campaign Execution

 * Coordinate the production of campaign assets as the internal project owner on zerothird's side
 * Manage timelines, external inputs, and internal review cycles for each campaign element
 * Track and report KPIs in a structured format

Your Profile

 * Several years of relevant experience in communications, public affairs, or agency account management
 * Fluent in German and English - written and spoken, at the highest professional level. Additional languages a plus
 * Strong written output: you can draft press releases, LinkedIn posts, and political briefings in the same week - all without heavy revision
 * Sharp eye for visual quality and corporate identity - you notice when something is off and you know how to fix it
 * Proven experience managing external agencies - briefing well, pushing back constructively, holding partners accountable
 * AI-native working style - you use AI tools to produce faster, structure better, and maintain the knowledge base that keeps this operation running
 * Structured, proactive, and diplomatically assertive - comfortable managing upwards and sideways
 * Familiarity with deep tech, cybersecurity, or policy-adjacent sectors is an advantage; start-up or scale-up experience is a strong plus

What We Offer

 * A front-row seat at one of Europe's most consequential deep-tech scale-ups
 * The opportunity to build zerothird's communications function from the ground up - with the backing of world-class agency partners
 * Direct collaboration with founders and senior leadership
 * Vienna-based, with travel across Europe as required

The minimum gross salary for this position is €3.586,73 per month (based on full-time employment) in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. However, there is a willingness to offer a higher salary depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
At PALFINGER, we have been lifting people and goods to a new level for over 90 years - with a pioneering and passionate spirit. As a global technology and engineering company, we are the world's leading manufacturer and supplier of innovative crane and lifting solutions. Wir suchen 1 SOC Analyst with German (f/m/d) @ A1 Competence Delivery Center As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting customer environments against cyber threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, coordinate response activities and support customers in maintaining a strong security posture.

The role combines hands-on cybersecurity operations with incident investigation and customer-focused security support, providing exposure to diverse technologies, threat landscapes and international security environments.

Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Detection

Monitor customer environments for security threats, suspicious activities and policy violations, ensuring timely identification of potential risks.

Alert Analysis & Triage

Analyze and prioritize security alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, cloud and other security technologies, determining appropriate response actions.

Incident Investigation

Investigate security incidents, assess their severity, impact and business relevance, and distinguish between true positive and false positive events.

Incident Escalation & Response Support

Escalate validated incidents to customer security teams in accordance with established procedures and SLAs, while supporting incident response activities when required.

Customer Communication

Communicate incident details, recommendations and investigation findings to customers in a clear, professional and customer-oriented manner.

Threat Analysis & Correlation

Correlate information from multiple data sources to identify malicious activity, emerging threats and attack patterns across complex environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Document investigations, findings and response actions within ticketing and case management systems, while contributing to threat hunting, detection improvements and SOC process optimization.

Collaboration & Security Enhancement

Work closely with international colleagues, customers and technology partners to strengthen overall security capabilities and improve customer security posture.

Your Profile

 * Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, Incident Response or a similar cybersecurity role

 * Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident handling processes

 * Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar or similar technologies

 * Familiarity with EDR/XDR solutions, Microsoft Defender, network security monitoring and cloud security services

 * Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess and prioritize security events effectively

 * Experience working in a customer-facing environment and communicating technical findings to various audiences

 * Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple incidents and maintain attention to detail

 * German language proficiency at C1 level or native speaker (mandatory)

 * Strong English communication skills
